noodles.text_en: You can choose any noodle shape, just let us know when you order. Noodle soups come with regular thin; fried and mixed noodles come with 2nd thin.
noodles.text_zh: 您可以选择任何面型，点餐时告知我们即可。汤面默认细面，炒面、拌面默认二细。

photo.alt_en: Chart of eight noodle shapes in white bowls: 2nd thin, 3rd thin, regular thin, extra thin, chive leaf, triangular, wide and belt wide
photo.alt_zh: 八种面型图：二细、三细、细面、毛细、韭叶子、三棱子、宽面、大宽

notes_en: Please let us know your taste preference: mild, medium hot or hot, and whether you're vegetarian.
A packaging fee of $1 applies to each takeaway item.
notes_zh: 请告知我们您对辣味的接受程度（微辣、中辣、特辣）以及是否为素食主义者。
所有外卖单品需要额外支付餐盒费 $1.00。

categories.note_en: Noodle soups come with regular thin noodles. Any noodle shape on request.
categories.note_zh: 汤面默认细面，面型任选，请告知我们。
